description: Swift extension for CronSettings that provides SwiftUI view components for managing and displaying cron jobs within an application.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main SwiftUI view layout for the CronSettings extension, including header, content, and interactions.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a banner indicating whether the cron scheduler is enabled, with additional info.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Provides the top header section with title and control buttons for refreshing jobs and creating new ones.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Main content area displaying error/status messages, list of jobs, and detailed view for selected job.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Details view that shows information and run history of the selected cron job or a prompt to select a job.
